title: Selection-explanation emitter with near-miss disclosure
question: Implement the explanation record: for each selection, why this capability, which rule or score produced it, and which capabilities were near-misses that did NOT make the cut. Exact question: can an owner reading only the explanation reconstruct the decision without re-running the router?
claim_under_test: An owner given only the explanation record and the capability index can reproduce the selected set without re-running the router; near-misses that did not make the cut are named with a cutoff reason.
decision_procedure: 1. BAN beats every fusion score; a banned capability is never selected.
2. PIN is admitted first and its token_cost is reserved against the budget even when fusion_score is below min_score.
3. Remaining unbanned, unpinned candidates are considered in fusion_score descending order (capability_id tie-break).
4. A candidate with fusion_score < min_score is skipped unless it was pinned in step 2.
5. A candidate whose token_cost would exceed remaining budget is skipped.
6. Near-misses that did NOT make the cut are every non-selected candidate that was banned or scored at or above min_score; each carries cutoff_reason.
